disorder-name.detail: Multiple Sclerosis (demyelinating disorder); clinical cohort of 326 MS patients from five datasets
disorder-name.supporting_text: "By comparing subcortical volumes of 326 MS patients to a normative model from 37,407 healthy individuals"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three in-house datasets (CHUV, NIL, INsIDER) and two public datasets (MSSEG2016, OpenMSLong). Total N=326.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We analyzed a heterogeneous dataset comprising 326 MS patients from five sources: three in-house datasets (Lausanne University Hospital (CHUV), Louvain Neuroinflammation Imaging Lab (NIL), and Imaging Axonal Damage & Repair in Multiple Sclerosis (INsIDER)) and two public datasets (MICCAIMSSEG2016 challenge and OpenMSLong)."

age.detail: Weighted mean calculated from per-dataset N and mean age: MSSEG2016 (N=53, mean=45.15), OpenMSLong (N=20, mean=34.10), CHUV (N=41, mean=34.51), NIL (N=47, mean=40.64), INsIDER (N=165, mean=46.44). Overall min=18.27 (INsIDER), overall max=76.51 (INsIDER). SD not reported per dataset; pooled SD not calculable (NR).

sex.detail: Female N summed across datasets: MSSEG2016=38, OpenMSLong=15, CHUV=25, NIL=26, INsIDER=98; total female=202 (62.0%). Male N estimated as 326-202=124 (38.0%).
